literature.headline_zh: 诺如病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期诺如病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 45.4% 的患者检测到病毒病原体,其中 诺如病毒 最为常见,占 27.7%。GII.7[P7]与韩国和俄罗斯的2024株表现出密切的相关性。 [10.1186/s12879-026-14187-5]
研究发现,太阳辐射和水温是牡蛎诺如病毒 暴发最重要的两个预测因子。此外,它还揭示了 暴发 对长达 30 天前的先前海洋环境条件的强烈长期依赖性。 [10.1080/09603123.2026.2716639]
PFM 可以准确预测潮汐和波浪,并适度预测深度平均陆架流。对于 13 公里海岸线上的第 1 天和第 5 天预测,预测的示踪剂浓度和观察到的肠球菌水平显示出中等对数相关性 (≈0.5)。示踪剂和肠球菌之间的幂律关系的指数约为 0.5。 [10.1021/acs.est.6c04225]
新鲜农产品可能会通过土壤、灌溉水、有机改良剂、野生动物、收获设备、储存环境和人类处理而受到人类 诺如病毒 的污染,从而促进病毒病原体的引入和传播。 [10.22194/pdc/5.1086]

早期阶段(<6 个月)主要以无症状感染和强烈的母体影响为特征,随后是 6 至 18 个月之间的临床易感性关键窗口期。这一时期恰逢被动保护的断奶和减弱,表现出强烈母性影响的峰值和由分泌依赖型显性基因型引起的无症状感染(诺如病毒 GII.4,轮状病毒P[8])。此外,糖萼成熟可调节 疫苗 的实时性能。 [Ontogeny of human intestinal glycans and its impact on susceptibility to enteric viral infections in children up to 5 ye]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: Viral pathogens were detected in 45.4% of patients, with norovirus being the most prevalent at 27.7%. GII.7[P7] showed close relatedness to 2024 strains from South Korea and Russia. [10.1186/s12879-026-14187-5]

The study found that solar radiation and water temperature are the two most important predictors of oyster norovirus outbreaks. Additionally, it revealed a strong long-range dependence of outbreaks on antecedent marine environmental conditions up to 30 days prior. [10.1080/09603123.2026.2716639]

The most prevalent pathogen detected, regardless of quantity or modeled etiologic attribution, was rotavirus (weighted prevalence 30.4%), followed by adenovirus 40/41 (19.1%), norovirus (17.9%), Shigella (14.1%), and Campylobacter jejuni/coli (8.6%). [10.64898/2026.07.26.26358975]

PFM accurately forecasts tides and waves and moderately predicts depth-averaged shelf currents. Forecasted tracer concentrations and observed Enterococcus levels showed moderate log-correlation (≈0.5) for day-1 and day-5 forecasts over 13 km of shoreline. [10.1021/acs.est.6c04225]

Fresh produce may become contaminated with human norovirus through soil, irrigation water, organic amendments, wildlife, harvesting equipment, storage environments, and human handling, facilitating introduction and dissemination of viral pathogens. [10.22194/pdc/5.1086]

news.headline_zh: 诺如病毒本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期诺如病毒新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: 《食品安全新闻》报道了对香港十多年来诺如病毒 暴发的分析,强调了与诺如病毒相关的生蚝暴发的增长。 [news-42dcadfe1b3ecb29]
在 CHU Bordeaux,Frédéric Gabriel 博士花了数年时间完善他的实验室如何使用 β-D-葡聚糖 (BDG) 测试来提高判断力,包括使用 Wako β-葡聚糖测试。 [news-ebcdd33790900d00]
美国疾病控制与预防中心 (CDC) 报告称,“加勒比公主”号游轮上发生了导致 急性胃肠炎 的 诺如病毒 暴发 感染。 [news-05916f1278528a96]
在游轮上报告胃肠道疾病 暴发;美国疾病控制与预防中心 (CDC) 证实了这一事件;原因仍在调查中。 [news-ecc7ea0980cda5a7]
与 2024 年相比,2025 年报告的食物中毒 暴发 和病例有所增加,归因于沙门氏菌和 诺如病毒;食品药品安全部官方数据公布。 [news-b92426529a25b65f]
news.trend_or_risk_zh: 风险判断仅依据入选来源已经确认的信息，不把媒体推测升级为官方结论。
news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Norovirus news developments.
key_findings_en: Analysis of norovirus outbreaks over a decade in Hong Kong, reported by Food Safety News, highlighting the growing prevalence of norovirus-related raw oyster outbreaks. [news-42dcadfe1b3ecb29]
At CHU Bordeaux, Dr Frédéric Gabriel has spent years refining how his lab uses β-D-glucan (BDG) testing to sharpen that judgement call – including with the Wako β-glucan test. [news-ebcdd33790900d00]
A norovirus outbreak causing acute gastroenteritis was reported aboard the cruise ship 'Caribbean Princess' by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC). [news-05916f1278528a96]
Reported gastrointestinal illness outbreak on a cruise ship; the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) confirmed the event; cause remains under investigation. [news-ecc7ea0980cda5a7]

Reported increase in food poisoning outbreaks and cases in 2025 compared to 2024, attributed to Salmonella and norovirus; official data released by the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety. [news-b92426529a25b65f]

papers.title: Treatment With Ruxolitinib and TAK-779 Enhances GII.17 Human Norovirus Replication and Enables Serial Passaging in Human Intestinal Enteroids.
papers.abstract: Human norovirus (HuNoV) is a major cause of acute viral gastroenteritis. Although it can be replicated in vitro using human intestinal enteroids (HIEs), generating high-titer viral laboratory stocks remains challenging due to low infection and passage efficiencies. Interferon response and chemokine signaling may be key host pathways that restrict efficient HuNoV replication. Here, we evaluated the effect of their inhibitors, ruxolitinib-a Janus kinase (JAK) 1/JAK2 inhibitor-and TAK-779-a C-X-C motif chemokine receptor 3 (CXCR3)/C-C motif chemokine receptor (CCR) 5/CCR2 antagonist-on HuNoV replication in wild-type jejunal HIEs. TAK-779 increased GII.17 HuNoV replication by 2.3- and 6.0-fold at 48 and 96 h postinfection (hpi), respectively, compared with the DMSO-treated control. In contrast, ruxolitinib alone did not affect viral replication. Notably, simultaneous treatment with these compounds further enhanced GII.17 replication by 6.0- and 10.7-fold at 48 and 96 hpi, respectively, which enabled serial passaging. These findings imply that the simultaneous suppression of these pathways potentially benefits GII.17 HuNoV replication.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the impact of ruxolitinib and TAK-779 on GII.17 human norovirus (HuNoV) replication in human intestinal enteroids (HIEs). The research aimed to address the challenge of generating high-titer viral stocks due to low replication efficiency. The results showed that TAK-779 significantly increased viral replication at 48 and 96 hpi, while ruxolitinib alone had no effect. Simultaneous treatment with both compounds led to a further enhancement, enabling serial passaging. These findings suggest that targeting interferon response and chemokine signaling pathways could improve HuNoV replication in vitro. The study provides insights into potential therapeutic strategies for norovirus infections but has limited implications for broader applications due to its focus on a specific viral genotype and in vitro model.

papers.title: Modeling and forecasting oyster norovirus outbreaks of long-range dependence on antecedent marine environmental conditions
papers.abstract: This study presents three artificial intelligence-based models - XGBoost, Random Forest (RF), and Deep Artificial Neural Network (DANN) - with 2-day lead time for forecasting broad-scale oyster norovirus outbreaks. Among them, the XGBoost model performs best and is characterized by unique features: (1) the model was constructed and tested with epidemiological and environmental data collected from three distinct coastal countries representing broad trends in oyster norovirus outbreaks; (2) model input variables include five important environmental predictors (along with their time-lags ranging from 2-30 days), identified by using Pearson correlation and Gini index, including solar radiation, water temperature, gage height, precipitation, and salinity plus GPS coordinates, which affect various processes governing the sources and sinks of oyster norovirus; and (3) the model output performance is characterized by a high accuracy, demonstrating the strongest overall prediction performance. This study identifies solar radiation and water temperature as the two most important predictors of oyster norovirus outbreaks. Another major finding is the strong long-range dependence of outbreaks on antecedent marine environmental conditions up to 30 days before. These novel features of the XGBoost model provide an effective early-warning framework that can support proactive management of oyster norovirus outbreaks.
papers.journal: International Journal of Environmental Health Research

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to develop an early-warning framework for forecasting oyster norovirus outbreaks by leveraging environmental predictors. The research addresses the challenge of understanding and predicting the spread of norovirus in oyster populations, which is critical for public health and food safety.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study employed three artificial intelligence-based models - XGBoost, Random Forest (RF), and Deep Artificial Neural Network (DANN) - to forecast oyster norovirus outbreaks with a 2-day lead time. These models were constructed and tested using epidemiological and environmental data from three distinct coastal countries.
analysis.methods: The XGBoost model was selected for its superior performance, incorporating five environmental predictors (solar radiation, water temperature, gage height, precipitation, and salinity) along with their time-lags ranging from 2-30 days. These variables were identified using Pearson correlation and Gini index analyses.
analysis.main_results: The study found that solar radiation and water temperature are the two most important predictors of oyster norovirus outbreaks. Additionally, it revealed a strong long-range dependence of outbreaks on antecedent marine environmental conditions up to 30 days prior.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The novel features of the XGBoost model, including its use of environmental predictors and time-lagged data, provide an effective early-warning framework for managing oyster norovirus outbreaks.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform proactive management strategies for oyster norovirus outbreaks, enhancing surveillance and risk assessment efforts in coastal regions.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's evidence is based on data from three coastal countries, which may limit generalisability. However, the high accuracy of the XGBoost model suggests strong predictive performance.

analysis.summary_en: This study presents three artificial intelligence-based models - XGBoost, Random Forest (RF), and Deep Artificial Neural Network (DANN) - for forecasting oyster norovirus outbreaks with a 2-day lead time. The XGBoost model, which incorporates environmental predictors such as solar radiation and water temperature, demonstrated the highest accuracy. The research identifies solar radiation and water temperature as the most significant factors influencing outbreaks and highlights the long-range dependence of these outbreaks on antecedent marine environmental conditions up to 30 days prior. The findings suggest that the XGBoost model can serve as an effective early-warning framework for managing norovirus outbreaks in oyster populations. While the study's data are limited to three coastal countries, the high accuracy of the model indicates strong evidence for its predictive capabilities. These results have implications for improving surveillance and risk assessment strategies in coastal regions to mitigate the public health risks associated with norovirus contamination in oysters.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在利用环境预测因子开发一个预测牡蛎 诺如病毒 暴发 的预警框架。该研究解决了理解和预测 诺如病毒 在牡蛎种群中传播的挑战,这对公共卫生和食品安全至关重要。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究采用了三种基于人工智能的模型——XGBoost、随机森林(RF)和深度人工神经网络(DANN)——来预测牡蛎 诺如病毒 暴发,提前期为 2 天。这些模型是利用来自三个不同沿海国家的流行病学和环境数据构建和测试的。
elements_zh.methods: XGBoost 模型因其卓越的性能而被选中,该模型包含五个环境预测因子(太阳辐射、水温、标高、降水和盐度)及其 2-30 天的时滞。这些变量是使用皮尔逊相关性和基尼指数分析确定的。
elements_zh.main_results: 研究发现,太阳辐射和水温是牡蛎诺如病毒 暴发最重要的两个预测因子。此外,它还揭示了 暴发 对长达 30 天前的先前海洋环境条件的强烈长期依赖性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: XGBoost 模型的新颖功能,包括使用环境预测变量和时滞数据,为管理牡蛎 诺如病毒 暴发 提供了有效的预警框架。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可为牡蛎 诺如病毒 暴发 的主动管理策略提供信息,加强沿海地区的 监测 和风险评估工作。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的证据基于三个沿海国家的数据,这可能会限制普遍性。然而,XGBoost 模型的高精度表明预测性能很强。

papers.source_body_en: This study presents three artificial intelligence-based models - XGBoost, Random Forest (RF), and Deep Artificial Neural Network (DANN) - with 2-day lead time for forecasting broad-scale oyster norovirus outbreaks. Among them, the XGBoost model performs best and is characterized by unique features: (1) the model was constructed and tested with epidemiological and environmental data collected from three distinct coastal countries representing broad trends in oyster norovirus outbreaks; (2) model input variables include five important environmental predictors (along with their time-lags ranging from 2-30 days), identified by using Pearson correlation and Gini index, including solar radiation, water temperature, gage height, precipitation, and salinity plus GPS coordinates, which affect various processes governing the sources and sinks of oyster norovirus; and (3) the model output performance is characterized by a high accuracy, demonstrating the strongest overall prediction performance. This study identifies solar radiation and water temperature as the two most important predictors of oyster norovirus outbreaks. Another major finding is the strong long-range dependence of outbreaks on antecedent marine environmental conditions up to 30 days before. These novel features of the XGBoost model provide an effective early-warning framework that can support proactive management of oyster norovirus outbreaks.

papers.full_text: Abstract Background To investigate the molecular epidemiology of viral diarrhea, phylogenetic analysis and clinical features of norovirus diarrhea in adult outpatients in Beijing, China during 2023–2024. Methods Fecal samples from 238 outpatients with diarrhea were tested by real-time RT-PCR or PCR for five enteric viruses. Clinical features were compared between norovirus-positive and norovirus-negative cases. Genotyping and whole-genome sequencing were performed for norovirus. Results Viral pathogens were detected in 45.4% of patients. NoV was most prevalent (27.7%), followed by rotavirus, astrovirus, sapovirus, and adenovirus. Symptoms differed significantly between norovirus and non- norovirus cases. Predominant norovirus genotypes included GII.4[P16], GII.7[P7], and GII.17[P17]. GII.17 strains co-circulated as capsid lineages IIIa and IIIb, with polymerase regions linked to recent European clusters. GII.7[P7] showed close relatedness to 2024 strains from South Korea and Russia. Conclusions Norovirus remains the leading cause of adult viral diarrhea in outpatients in post-pandemic Beijing, with multiple genotypes co-circulating. Non-GII.4 genotypes demonstrate ongoing evolution and transmission potential. analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the molecular epidemiology of viral diarrhea and the clinical features of norovirus diarrhea in adult outpatients in Beijing, China during 2023–2024.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A cross-sectional study was conducted in Beijing, China, from 2023 to 2024, involving 238 outpatients with diarrhea. The study focused on adult participants and analyzed fecal samples for viral pathogens.
analysis.methods: Fecal samples were tested using real-time RT-PCR or PCR for five enteric viruses, including norovirus. Genotyping and whole-genome sequencing were performed for norovirus-positive cases to determine genetic lineages and relatedness to other strains.
analysis.main_results: Viral pathogens were detected in 45.4% of patients, with norovirus being the most prevalent at 27.7%. GII.7[P7] showed close relatedness to 2024 strains from South Korea and Russia.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings highlight the ongoing evolution and transmission potential of non-GII.4 norovirus genotypes, emphasizing the need for continued surveillance and updated diagnostic methods.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study provides insights into the circulating norovirus genotypes in post-pandemic Beijing, which can inform surveillance strategies and improve the accuracy of diagnostic testing for norovirus gastroenteritis.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study was conducted in a single hospital, which may limit generalizability. The evidence is moderate as it is based on a cross-sectional design and molecular analysis of a specific population.

analysis.summary_en: This study conducted a phylogenetic analysis and examined clinical characteristics of sporadic norovirus diarrhea in adult outpatients in Beijing, China, during 2023–2024. It aimed to understand the molecular epidemiology of viral diarrhea and the role of norovirus in causing gastroenteritis. The research involved testing fecal samples using real-time RT-PCR and PCR for five enteric viruses, including norovirus, and performing genotyping and whole-genome sequencing on positive cases. papers.title: Etiology and incidence of diarrhea requiring hospitalization in children under 5 years of age in 31 low- and middle-income countries: findings from the Global Pediatric Diarrhea Surveillance network, 2017-2022
papers.abstract: Diarrhea remains a leading cause of child morbidity and mortality. Improved and ongoing estimates of the etiology of hospitalized pediatric diarrhea in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) are needed to help prioritize and evaluate the use of existing and upcoming vaccines and interventions. The Global Pediatric Diarrhea Surveillance (GPDS) network is a World Health Organization (WHO)-coordinated public health surveillance network investigating the etiology of hospitalized diarrhea among children aged <5 years in LMICs. The GPDS network enrolls children hospitalized with diarrhea at 38 sentinel surveillance sites in 31 LMICs. Randomly selected stool specimens were tested by TaqMan Array Card quantitative reverse-transcription polymerase chain reaction (qPCR) for 16 pathogens associated with diarrhea. We estimated pathogen-specific attributable fractions (AFs) and incidence of diarrheal hospitalizations at the global, regional, and country levels during 3 time periods: 2017-2018, 2019-2020, and 2021-2022, with a focus on the most recent results. During 2017-2022, the GPDS network enrolled 70,750 children aged <5 years hospitalized with diarrhea, of which 16,458 (23.3%) were randomly selected for qPCR testing. The most prevalent pathogen detected, regardless of quantity or modeled etiologic attribution, was rotavirus (weighted prevalence 30.4%), followed by adenovirus 40/41 (19.1%), norovirus (17.9%), Shigella (14.1%), and Campylobacter jejuni/coli (8.6%). Overall, in 2017-2022, rotavirus was the leading etiology globally (AF 32.5%; 95% Confidence Interval (CI): 27.4, 37.6), followed by Shigella (9.8%; 8.4, 11.3), adenovirus 40/41 (8.6%; 6.3, 10.8) and norovirus (6.7%; 5.6, 7.7). Over time, rotavirus consistently declined from an AF of 36.7% (95% CI: 28.7, 46.7) in 2017-2018 to 26.7% (20.7, 34.1) in 2021-2022. Norovirus AF increased slightly from 6.2% (4.7, 7.7) in 2017-2018 to 7.3% (5.0, 9.2) in 2021-2022. Global Shigella burden remained stable, and adenovirus 40/41 demonstrated significant volatility, peaking globally in 2019-2020 (11.9%; 5.9, 17.5). In 2021-2022, rotavirus was the leading cause of hospitalized diarrhea in 6 of 9 geographic groupings, norovirus predominated in Central and South America, and Shigella was the leading etiology in South Asia. In the subset of countries that had introduced rotavirus vaccine, the leading etiologies in 2021-2022 were rotavirus (18.4%; 15.8, 21.5) and Shigella (16.4%; 11.8, 21.1). In 2021-2022, rotavirus had the highest attributable incidence of hospitalized diarrhea in children (2.3 per 1,000 child-years; 1.8, 3.0), followed by Shigella (0.9; 0.7, 1.1), norovirus (0.6; 0.4, 0.8) and adenovirus 40/41 (0.6; 0.4, 0.8). Despite the widespread use of rotavirus vaccines, rotavirus remained the leading cause of severe diarrhea among children aged <5 years in LMICs globally. However, the proportion of pediatric diarrhea attributable to rotavirus consistently declined from 2017-2018 to 2021-2022, and there were notable differences in the distribution of diarrheal etiologies between regions and across time periods. Shigella, norovirus, and enteric adenoviruses were also associated with a substantial burden of disease. Improving the efficacy and coverage of rotavirus vaccination and prioritizing interventions against other enteric pathogens could further reduce diarrhea morbidity and mortality.

papers.title_zh: 31 个低收入和中等收入国家 5 岁以下儿童需要住院治疗的腹泻的病因和 发病率:来自全球小儿腹泻 监测 网络的调查结果,2017-2022 年
papers.source_body_en: Diarrhea remains a leading cause of child morbidity and mortality. Improved and ongoing estimates of the etiology of hospitalized pediatric diarrhea in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) are needed to help prioritize and evaluate the use of existing and upcoming vaccines and interventions. The Global Pediatric Diarrhea Surveillance (GPDS) network is a World Health Organization (WHO)-coordinated public health surveillance network investigating the etiology of hospitalized diarrhea among children aged <5 years in LMICs. The GPDS network enrolls children hospitalized with diarrhea at 38 sentinel surveillance sites in 31 LMICs. Randomly selected stool specimens were tested by TaqMan Array Card quantitative reverse-transcription polymerase chain reaction (qPCR) for 16 pathogens associated with diarrhea. We estimated pathogen-specific attributable fractions (AFs) and incidence of diarrheal hospitalizations at the global, regional, and country levels during 3 time periods: 2017-2018, 2019-2020, and 2021-2022, with a focus on the most recent results. During 2017-2022, the GPDS network enrolled 70,750 children aged <5 years hospitalized with diarrhea, of which 16,458 (23.3%) were randomly selected for qPCR testing. The most prevalent pathogen detected, regardless of quantity or modeled etiologic attribution, was rotavirus (weighted prevalence 30.4%), followed by adenovirus 40/41 (19.1%), norovirus (17.9%), Shigella (14.1%), and Campylobacter jejuni/coli (8.6%). Overall, in 2017-2022, rotavirus was the leading etiology globally (AF 32.5%; 95% Confidence Interval (CI): 27.4, 37.6), followed by Shigella (9.8%; 8.4, 11.3), adenovirus 40/41 (8.6%; 6.3, 10.8) and norovirus (6.7%; 5.6, 7.7). Over time, rotavirus consistently declined from an AF of 36.7% (95% CI: 28.7, 46.7) in 2017-2018 to 26.7% (20.7, 34.1) in 2021-2022. Norovirus AF increased slightly from 6.2% (4.7, 7.7) in 2017-2018 to 7.3% (5.0, 9.2) in 2021-2022. Global Shigella burden remained stable, and adenovirus 40/41 demonstrated significant volatility, peaking globally in 2019-2020 (11.9%; 5.9, 17.5). In 2021-2022, rotavirus was the leading cause of hospitalized diarrhea in 6 of 9 geographic groupings, norovirus predominated in Central and South America, and Shigella was the leading etiology in South Asia. In the subset of countries that had introduced rotavirus vaccine, the leading etiologies in 2021-2022 were rotavirus (18.4%; 15.8, 21.5) and Shigella (16.4%; 11.8, 21.1). In 2021-2022, rotavirus had the highest attributable incidence of hospitalized diarrhea in children (2.3 per 1,000 child-years; 1.8, 3.0), followed by Shigella (0.9; 0.7, 1.1), norovirus (0.6; 0.4, 0.8) and adenovirus 40/41 (0.6; 0.4, 0.8). Despite the widespread use of rotavirus vaccines, rotavirus remained the leading cause of severe diarrhea among children aged <5 years in LMICs globally. However, the proportion of pediatric diarrhea attributable to rotavirus consistently declined from 2017-2018 to 2021-2022, and there were notable differences in the distribution of diarrheal etiologies between regions and across time periods. Shigella, norovirus, and enteric adenoviruses were also associated with a substantial burden of disease. Improving the efficacy and coverage of rotavirus vaccination and prioritizing interventions against other enteric pathogens could further reduce diarrhea morbidity and mortality.

papers.title: Microbial assessment of recontamination with multidrug-resistant Acinetobacter in patient room environment in a burn unit.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Numerous studies have demonstrated that environmental contamination with several epidemiologically important pathogens, including methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus, vancomycin-resistant Enterococcus spp, Acinetobacter, norovirus, and Clostridioides difficile, can persist for several days to months and contributes to the transmission of these pathogens. METHODS: This study was conducted in a burn intensive care unit to determine the time to recontamination of environmental surfaces with a multidrug-resistant Acinetobacter baumannii after disinfection. After disinfection, samples were taken from 6 environmental sites using Rodac plates at 1-hour intervals for 10 hours. RESULTS: Time to recontamination with Acinetobacter was as follows: chair, 3 hours; overbed table, 2 hours; stock cabinet, 3 hours; and IV pump, 2 hours. CONCLUSIONS: Our study demonstrated that recontamination with Acinetobacter occurred rapidly at environmental sites in burn units even after cleaning/disinfection and underscored the need for enhanced environmental cleaning, including continuous disinfection methods, to prevent transmission of health care-associated pathogens.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the time to recontamination of environmental surfaces in a burn unit with multidrug-resistant Acinetobacter baumannii after disinfection. The research was motivated by the understanding that environmental contamination with pathogens like Acinetobacter, norovirus, and others can persist for extended periods and contribute to their transmission. The study design involved sampling six environmental sites using Rodac plates at 1-hour intervals for 10 hours. Results showed that recontamination occurred rapidly at various sites, with the chair and stock cabinet taking 3 hours and the overbed table and IV pump taking 2 hours. The authors concluded that enhanced environmental cleaning, including continuous disinfection methods, is necessary to prevent the spread of healthcare-associated pathogens. The study's findings have specific implications for infection control practices in burn units, emphasizing the need for improved disinfection protocols. However, the evidence does not report limitations or evidence strength, which may affect the confidence in the conclusions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 大量研究表明,几种流行病学上重要的病原体(包括耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌、耐万古霉素肠球菌、不动杆菌、诺如病毒 和艰难梭菌)的环境污染可以持续数天至数月,并导致这些病原体的 传播。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项研究是在烧伤重症监护室进行的,旨在确定消毒后环境表面被多重耐药鲍曼不动杆菌再次污染的时间。
elements_zh.methods: 消毒后,使用Rodac板在6个环境点采样10小时,每隔1小时采样一次。
elements_zh.main_results: 不动杆菌再污染的时间如下:椅子,3小时;床头柜,2小时;库存柜,3小时;和 IV 泵,2 小时。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 我们的研究表明,即使在清洁/消毒后,不动杆菌的再污染也会在烧伤单位的环境部位迅速发生,并强调需要加强环境清洁,包括持续消毒方法,以防止医疗保健相关病原体的 传播。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调了烧伤科室中连续消毒方法对于预防不动杆菌等医疗保健相关病原体的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 提供的证据并未报告研究的局限性或证据强度。

papers.title: Pathogens at the Pre- and Post-Harvest Interface: Food Safety Risks and Controls
papers.abstract: The pre- and post-harvest interface represents a critical control zone in the food supply chain where microbial contamination can compromise the safety, quality, and shelf-life. Although numerous studies have examined pre-harvest contamination and post-harvest disease management separately, limited reviews have comprehensively addressed the critical interface linking these stages. This review synthesizes current knowledge on contamination pathways, major pathogens, monitoring approaches, and integrated control strategies associated with fresh fruits and vegetables. Relevant peer-reviewed literature was critically evaluated to provide an overview of food safety risks and management options across the production chain. Fresh produce may become contaminated through soil, irrigation water, organic amendments, wildlife, harvesting equipment, storage environments, and human handling. These pathways facilitate the introduction and dissemination of bacterial, fungal, and viral pathogens. Major bacterial hazards include Salmonella enterica, Escherichia coli O157, and Listeria monocytogenes, while fungal pathogens such as Aspergillus, Fusarium, and Penicillium species contribute to spoilage and mycotoxin production. Viral pathogens, particularly norovirus and hepatitis A virus, are also important causes of produce-associated outbreaks. Environmental stressors, including drought, heavy rainfall, temperature fluctuations, and crop injuries, further increase contamination risks. The review highlights integrated management strategies, including Good Agricultural Practices (GAPs), sanitation programs, rapid cooling, biological control agents, and emerging decontamination technologies. Among these, ozone and cold plasma show strong antimicrobial potential, although their large-scale adoption is constrained by economic and technical limitations. Environmental Monitoring Programs (EMPs), molecular detection tools such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR), loop-mediated isothermal amplification (LAMP), and next-generation sequencing (NGS), together with blockchain-based traceability systems, support rapid pathogen detection and outbreak prevention. Integrating the Food Safety Objective (FSO) framework with One Health principles provides a sustainable approach for reducing contamination risks throughout the supply chain. Future research should focus on improving the cost-effectiveness, scalability, and practical implementation of emerging monitoring and intervention technologies. Keywords: Pre-harvest, post-harvest, food safety, fresh produce, microbial contamination, mycotoxins, biofilms, traceability, good agricultural practices, environmental monitoring programs.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines human norovirus as a food safety hazard at the pre- and post-harvest interface of fresh produce, focusing on contamination pathways, monitoring approaches, and integrated control strategies that specifically address norovirus transmission and infection risks in humans.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a narrative synthesis of peer-reviewed literature critically evaluated to provide an overview of food safety risks and management options across the production chain, with no systematic search, pooled estimates, or meta-analytic methods reported.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Fresh produce may become contaminated with human norovirus through soil, irrigation water, organic amendments, wildlife, harvesting equipment, storage environments, and human handling, facilitating introduction and dissemination of viral pathogens.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review does not report specific evidence on norovirus detection methods, prevalence estimates, or comparative effectiveness of interventions in fresh produce systems, leaving gaps in validated monitoring tools and scalable control strategies.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Future research should prioritize the development and validation of cost-effective, scalable norovirus-specific detection tools and intervention technologies for pre- and post-harvest produce environments to reduce contamination risks.

analysis.summary_en: This review synthesizes evidence on human norovirus as a produce-associated food safety hazard at the pre- and post-harvest interface. It identifies contamination pathways including soil, irrigation water, organic amendments, wildlife, equipment, storage, and human handling as key routes for norovirus introduction and spread in fresh produce systems. The review highlights the need for integrated control strategies but does not provide pooled estimates, validated detection methods, or comparative intervention data specific to norovirus. Major evidence gaps include the absence of standardized norovirus monitoring tools and scalable decontamination approaches in produce environments.

papers.abstract_zh: 收获前和收获后的界面是食品供应链中的关键控制区,微生物污染可能会影响安全、质量和保质期。尽管许多研究分别检查了收获前污染和收获后疾病管理,但有限的评论全面解决了连接这些阶段的关键界面。本综述综合了有关新鲜水果和蔬菜的污染途径、主要病原体、监测方法和综合控制策略的最新知识。对相关同行评审文献进行了严格评估,以概述整个生产链的食品安全风险和管理选项。新鲜农产品可能会因土壤、灌溉水、有机改良剂、野生动物、收割设备、储存环境和人类处理而受到污染。这些途径有利于细菌、真菌和病毒病原体的引入和传播。主要细菌危害包括肠沙门氏菌、大肠杆菌 O157 和单核细胞增生李斯特氏菌,而曲霉属、镰刀菌属和青霉属等真菌病原体会导致腐败和产生霉菌毒素。病毒病原体,特别是诺如病毒和甲型肝炎病毒,也是农产品相关暴发的重要原因。干旱、强降雨、温度波动和作物损伤等环境压力进一步增加了污染风险。该审查强调了综合管理策略,包括良好农业规范(GAP)、卫生计划、快速冷却、生物防治剂和新兴净化技术。其中,臭氧和冷等离子体显示出强大的抗菌潜力,尽管它们的大规模采用受到经济和技术限制。环境监测计划(EMP)、聚合酶链式反应(PCR)、环介导等温扩增(LAMP)和下一代测序(NGS)等分子检测工具,以及基于区块链的可追溯系统,支持快速病原体检测和暴发预防。将食品安全目标 (FSO) 框架与“同一个健康”原则相结合,为降低整个供应链的污染风险提供了一种可持续的方法。未来的研究应侧重于提高新兴监测和干预技术的成本效益、可扩展性和实际实施。关键词:收获前、收获后、食品安全、新鲜农产品、微生物污染、霉菌毒素、生物膜、可追溯性、良好农业规范、环境监测计划。

papers.title: Pathogen Forecast Model Version 1.0: A Process-based Five-Day Beach Advisory Forecast System for the San Diego/Tijuana Region.
papers.abstract: The San Diego/Tijuana (US/Mexico) coastal region has immense water quality issues due to untreated wastewater sources. Regular ddPCR Enterococcus sampling provides same-day water quality information for beachgoers but does not provide forecasts for decision making. We describe the Pathogen Forecast Model (PFM) V1.0, providing daily 5 day forecasts of swimmer illness risk along 30 km of shoreline on a web dashboard. PFM is based upon a hydrodynamic model using forecasted waves, winds, offshore currents, and Tijuana River flow as inputs. PFM accurately forecasts tides and waves and forecasts depth-averaged shelf currents moderately well. Modeled untreated wastewater concentration tracer C evolves with a constant decay rate representing Norovirus. Over 13 km of shoreline, forecasted C and observed EnterococcusE are moderately log-correlated (≈0.5) for day-1 and -5 forecasts. The C and E power-law relationship has an exponent of ≈0.5, possibly suggesting the tracer decays 2× slower than Enterococcus DNA, among other potential explanations. Using the cutoff C = 10-5, PFM classified advisory exceedances with nearly 80% raw accuracy, high sensitivity, and lower specificity. This is the first forecast model that resolves estuarine, surfzone, and shelf regions. PFM is a useful public health tool and is constantly being improved.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The San Diego/Tijuana coastal region faces persistent water quality challenges due to untreated wastewater discharges, creating a public health need for timely risk forecasts for beachgoers. Existing same-day Enterococcus measurements provide limited decision-making value without predictive capacity.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study describes the development and evaluation of the Pathogen Forecast Model (PFM) V1.0, which generates daily 5-day forecasts of swimmer illness risk along 30 km of shoreline via a web dashboard. The model integrates hydrodynamic inputs including forecasted waves, winds, offshore currents, and Tijuana River flow.
analysis.methods: PFM uses a hydrodynamic model with forecasted environmental drivers to simulate tracer concentrations representing untreated wastewater decay modeled after Norovirus. Forecast accuracy was assessed by comparing modeled tracer concentrations with observed Enterococcus levels over 13 km of shoreline.
analysis.main_results: PFM accurately forecasts tides and waves and moderately predicts depth-averaged shelf currents. Forecasted tracer concentrations and observed Enterococcus levels showed moderate log-correlation (≈0.5) for day-1 and day-5 forecasts over 13 km of shoreline. The power-law relationship between tracer and Enterococcus had an exponent of ≈0.5.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study reports that PFM is the first forecast model resolving estuarine, surfzone, and shelf regions, addressing a gap in spatially explicit risk prediction. The model's classification of advisory exceedances using a cutoff tracer concentration achieved nearly 80% raw accuracy with high sensitivity and lower specificity.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: PFM provides a public health tool for proactive beach advisories by forecasting pathogen risk up to five days in advance, potentially reducing swimmer illness through timely risk communication. The model's integration of hydrodynamic and tracer decay parameters offers a mechanistic basis for risk estimation.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is moderate due to reliance on a proxy tracer for Norovirus and moderate correlation with observed Enterococcus, which may not fully capture viral behavior. The model's specificity for advisory exceedances was lower than sensitivity, indicating potential overestimation of risk in some contexts.

analysis.summary_en: The Pathogen Forecast Model (PFM) V1.0 was developed to address persistent water quality issues in the San Diego/Tijuana coastal region by providing daily 5-day forecasts of swimmer illness risk along 30 km of shoreline. Using a hydrodynamic model driven by forecasted waves, winds, offshore currents, and Tijuana River flow, PFM simulates tracer concentrations representing untreated wastewater decay modeled after Norovirus. The model accurately forecasts tides and waves and moderately predicts shelf currents, with forecasted tracer concentrations showing moderate log-correlation (≈0.5) with observed Enterococcus levels over 13 km of shoreline. The power-law relationship between tracer and Enterococcus had an exponent of ≈0.5, suggesting differential decay rates. PFM classified advisory exceedances with nearly 80% raw accuracy, high sensitivity, and lower specificity. As the first model resolving estuarine, surfzone, and shelf regions, PFM offers a mechanistic tool for proactive public health advisories, though its reliance on a proxy tracer and moderate correlation with observed data limit confidence in direct Norovirus risk estimation.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 由于未经处理的废水排放,圣地亚哥/蒂华纳沿海地区面临着持续的水质挑战,这就产生了对海滩游客进行及时风险预测的公共卫生需求。现有的当日肠球菌测量提供的决策价值有限,缺乏预测能力。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究描述了病原体预测模型 (PFM) V1.0 的开发和评估,该模型通过网络仪表板生成 30 公里海岸线上游泳者疾病风险的每日 5 天预测。该模型集成了水动力输入,包括预测的波浪、风、离岸流和蒂华纳河流量。
elements_zh.methods: PFM 使用具有预测环境驱动因素的水动力模型来模拟代表未处理废水腐烂的示踪剂浓度,该浓度按照 诺如病毒 建模。通过将建模的示踪剂浓度与 13 公里海岸线上观察到的肠球菌水平进行比较来评估预测准确性。
elements_zh.main_results: PFM 可以准确预测潮汐和波浪,并适度预测深度平均陆架流。对于 13 公里海岸线上的第 1 天和第 5 天预测,预测的示踪剂浓度和观察到的肠球菌水平显示出中等对数相关性 (≈0.5)。示踪剂和肠球菌之间的幂律关系的指数约为 0.5。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究报告称,PFM 是第一个解决河口、海浪带和陆架区域问题的预测模型,解决了空间明确风险预测方面的空白。该模型使用截止示踪剂浓度对咨询超标进行分类,原始准确度接近 80%,且灵敏度高,特异性较低。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: PFM 可以提前五天预测病原体风险,为主动海滩咨询提供公共卫生工具,通过及时的风险沟通可能减少游泳者的疾病。该模型集成了流体动力学和示踪剂衰变参数,为风险估计提供了机械基础。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于依赖 诺如病毒 的代理示踪剂,并且与观察到的肠球菌具有中等相关性,因此证据强度为中等,这可能无法完全捕获病毒行为。该模型对咨询超标的特异性低于敏感性,表明在某些情况下可能高估风险。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 由于未经处理的废水排放,圣地亚哥/蒂华纳沿海地区面临着持续的水质挑战,这就产生了对海滩游客进行及时风险预测的公共卫生需求。现有的当日肠球菌测量提供的决策价值有限,缺乏预测能力。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究描述了病原体预测模型 (PFM) V1.0 的开发和评估,该模型通过网络仪表板生成 30 公里海岸线上游泳者疾病风险的每日 5 天预测。该模型集成了水动力输入,包括预测的波浪、风、离岸流和蒂华纳河流量。
analysis_zh.methods: PFM 使用具有预测环境驱动因素的水动力模型来模拟代表未处理废水腐烂的示踪剂浓度,该浓度按照 诺如病毒 建模。通过将建模的示踪剂浓度与 13 公里海岸线上观察到的肠球菌水平进行比较来评估预测准确性。
analysis_zh.main_results: PFM 可以准确预测潮汐和波浪,并适度预测深度平均陆架流。对于 13 公里海岸线上的第 1 天和第 5 天预测,预测的示踪剂浓度和观察到的肠球菌水平显示出中等对数相关性 (≈0.5)。示踪剂和肠球菌之间的幂律关系的指数约为 0.5。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究报告称,PFM 是第一个解决河口、海浪带和陆架区域问题的预测模型,解决了空间明确风险预测方面的空白。该模型使用截止示踪剂浓度对咨询超标进行分类,原始准确度接近 80%,且灵敏度高,特异性较低。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: PFM 可以提前五天预测病原体风险,为主动海滩咨询提供公共卫生工具,通过及时的风险沟通可能减少游泳者的疾病。该模型集成了流体动力学和示踪剂衰变参数,为风险估计提供了机械基础。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于依赖 诺如病毒 的代理示踪剂,并且与观察到的肠球菌具有中等相关性,因此证据强度为中等,这可能无法完全捕获病毒行为。该模型对咨询超标的特异性低于敏感性,表明在某些情况下可能高估风险。

papers.title: Ontogeny of human intestinal glycans and its impact on susceptibility to enteric viral infections in children up to 5 years of age: a scoping review.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Background: Human intestinal epithelial maturation involves cellular differentiation, structural maturation, and functional development. Within this context, intestinal glycans, including: histo-blood group antigens (HBGAs), sialic acids, and mucins, play key roles in host-pathogen interactions (serving as mucosal viral receptors, microbiota modulators) and innate mucosal immunity. Aim: To evaluate evidence on human intestinal mucosa development, glycan expression from the fetal stage through childhood, and susceptibility to enteric viral infections from the fetal stage through childhood. Materials and Methods: Following the PRISMA-ScR guidelines, a scoping review was conducted across Pubmed, Scopus, Cochrane Library, Embase, and Scielo for studies between 2010 and 2025. Information was extracted from original articles, observational studies, cohort studies, outbreak investigations, case-control studies, and experimental studies. Excel spreadsheets were used for article accounting. Results: Analysis of 24 studies identified an ontogenetic pattern of viral susceptibility. An early stage (<6 months) characterized by predominantly asymptomatic infections and a strong maternal influence is followed by a critical window of clinical vulnerability between 6 and 18 months. Coinciding with weaning and waning passive protection, this period exhibits peak strong maternal influence and asymptomatic infections caused by secretor-dependent dominant genotypes (Norovirus GII.4, Rotavirus P[8]). Furthermore, glycocalyx maturation modulates live vaccine performance. Conclusions: Enteric virus susceptibility is a dynamic developmental process driven by transition from passive maternal protection to endogenous mucosal glycosylation. Clinical disease depends on specific developmental time windows rather than fixed genetic status, highlighting the need for age-tailored immunization strategies beyond static binary secretor/non-secretor models. Key words: Intestinal glycans, HBGAs, enteric viral infections, human development, mucosa, infants.

analysis.summary_en: This scoping review explores the ontogeny of human intestinal glycans and its impact on susceptibility to enteric viral infections in children up to 5 years of age. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估有关人类肠粘膜发育、从胎儿期到儿童期的聚糖表达以及从胎儿期到儿童期对肠道病毒感染的易感性的证据。背景强调,人类肠上皮成熟涉及细胞分化、结构成熟和功能发育,这对于理解 宿主 与病原体的相互作用至关重要。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 对 Pubmed、Scopus、Cochrane 图书馆、Embase 和 Scielo 之间 2010 年至 2025 年间的研究进行了范围界定审查。信息是从原始文章、观察性研究、队列研究 研究、暴发 调查、病例对照研究和实验研究中提取的。该审查主要针对 5 岁以下的儿童。
elements_zh.methods: 遵循 PRISMA-ScR 指南,范围界定审查包括 2010 年至 2025 年间发表的研究。Excel 电子表格用于文章统计,对 24 项研究的分析确定了病毒易感性的个体发生模式。
elements_zh.main_results: 早期阶段(<6 个月)主要以无症状感染和强烈的母体影响为特征,随后是 6 至 18 个月之间的临床易感性关键窗口期。这一时期恰逢被动保护的断奶和减弱,表现出强烈母性影响的峰值和由分泌依赖型显性基因型引起的无症状感染(诺如病毒 GII.4,轮状病毒P[8])。此外,糖萼成熟可调节 疫苗 的实时性能。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为肠道病毒易感性是一个动态发育过程的证据,由被动母性保护向内源性粘膜糖基化的转变驱动。他们强调,临床疾病取决于特定的发育时间窗口而不是固定的遗传状态,这强调了除了静态二元分泌者/非分泌者模型之外,还需要针对年龄的免疫策略。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以通过强调发育时间窗对易感性和 疫苗 表现的重要性,为针对肠道病毒感染(特别是 诺如病毒 GII.4 和轮状病毒 P[8])制定针对年龄的免疫策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性在于其依赖截至 2025 年已发表的文献,并且纳入的研究之间可能存在异质性。证据强度中等,因为研究结果基于对 24 项研究的范围界定审查,而不是随机对照试验或纵向研究。

Materials and Methods: Following the PRISMA-ScR guidelines, a scoping review was conducted across Pubmed, Scopus, Cochrane Library, Embase, and Scielo for studies between 2010 and 2025. Information was extracted from original articles, observational studies, cohort studies, outbreak investigations, case-control studies, and experimental studies. Excel spreadsheets were used for article accounting. Results: Analysis of 24 studies identified an ontogenetic pattern of viral susceptibility. An early stage (<6 months) characterized by predominantly asymptomatic infections and a strong maternal influence is followed by a critical window of clinical vulnerability between 6 and 18 months. Coinciding with weaning and waning passive protection, this period exhibits peak strong maternal influence and asymptomatic infections caused by secretor-dependent dominant genotypes (Norovirus GII.4, Rotavirus P[8]). Furthermore, glycocalyx maturation modulates live vaccine performance. Conclusions: Enteric virus susceptibility is a dynamic developmental process driven by transition from passive maternal protection to endogenous mucosal glycosylation. Clinical disease depends on specific developmental time windows rather than fixed genetic status, highlighting the need for age-tailored immunization strategies beyond static binary secretor/non-secretor models. Key words: Intestinal glycans, HBGAs, enteric viral infections, human development, mucosa, infants.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要背景:人类肠上皮的成熟涉及细胞分化、结构成熟和功能发育。在此背景下,肠聚糖,包括:组织血型抗原 (HBGA)、唾液酸和粘蛋白,在 宿主-病原体相互作用(充当粘膜病毒受体、微生物群调节剂)和先天粘膜免疫中发挥关键作用。目的:评估有关人类肠粘膜发育、从胎儿期到儿童期的聚糖表达以及从胎儿期到儿童期对肠道病毒感染的易感性的证据。材料和方法:遵循 PRISMA-ScR 指南,对 Pubmed、Scopus、Cochrane 图书馆、Embase 和 Scielo 的 2010 年至 2025 年间的研究进行了范围界定审查。信息从原始文章、观察性研究、队列研究 研究、暴发 调查、病例对照研究和实验研究中提取。Excel 电子表格用于文章统计。结果:对 24 项研究的分析确定了病毒易感性的个体发生模式。早期阶段(<6 个月)主要以无症状感染和强烈的母体影响为特征,随后是 6 至 18 个月之间的临床易感性关键窗口期。与断奶和被动保护减弱相一致,这一时期表现出强烈的母体影响峰值和由分泌依赖型显性基因型引起的无症状感染(诺如病毒 GII.4,轮状病毒P [8])。此外,糖萼成熟可调节 疫苗 的实时性能。结论:肠道病毒易感性是一个由被动母体保护向内源性粘膜糖基化转变驱动的动态发展过程。临床疾病取决于特定的发育时间窗口而不是固定的遗传状态,这突出表明除了静态二元分泌者/非分泌者模型之外,还需要针对年龄的免疫策略。关键词:肠聚糖、HBGA、肠道病毒感染、人类发育、粘膜、婴儿。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估有关人类肠粘膜发育、从胎儿期到儿童期的聚糖表达以及从胎儿期到儿童期对肠道病毒感染的易感性的证据。背景强调,人类肠上皮成熟涉及细胞分化、结构成熟和功能发育,这对于理解 宿主 与病原体的相互作用至关重要。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 对 Pubmed、Scopus、Cochrane 图书馆、Embase 和 Scielo 之间 2010 年至 2025 年间的研究进行了范围界定审查。信息是从原始文章、观察性研究、队列研究 研究、暴发 调查、病例对照研究和实验研究中提取的。该审查主要针对 5 岁以下的儿童。
analysis_zh.methods: 遵循 PRISMA-ScR 指南,范围界定审查包括 2010 年至 2025 年间发表的研究。Excel 电子表格用于文章统计,对 24 项研究的分析确定了病毒易感性的个体发生模式。
analysis_zh.main_results: 早期阶段(<6 个月)主要以无症状感染和强烈的母体影响为特征,随后是 6 至 18 个月之间的临床易感性关键窗口期。这一时期恰逢被动保护的断奶和减弱,表现出强烈母性影响的峰值和由分泌依赖型显性基因型引起的无症状感染(诺如病毒 GII.4,轮状病毒P[8])。此外,糖萼成熟可调节 疫苗 的实时性能。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为肠道病毒易感性是一个动态发育过程的证据,由被动母性保护向内源性粘膜糖基化的转变驱动。他们强调,临床疾病取决于特定的发育时间窗口而不是固定的遗传状态,这强调了除了静态二元分泌者/非分泌者模型之外,还需要针对年龄的免疫策略。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以通过强调发育时间窗对易感性和 疫苗 表现的重要性,为针对肠道病毒感染(特别是 诺如病毒 GII.4 和轮状病毒 P[8])制定针对年龄的免疫策略提供信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性在于其依赖截至 2025 年已发表的文献,并且纳入的研究之间可能存在异质性。证据强度中等,因为研究结果基于对 24 项研究的范围界定审查,而不是随机对照试验或纵向研究。

news.content: Over a hundred norovirus cases hit the cruise ship "Caribbean Princess" during Caribbean voyage Home / Nautical Tourism / Over a hundred norovirus cases hit the cruise ship "Caribbean Princess" during... Stock photo of the mega cruise ship "Caribbean Princess" 12 May, 2026 by Alba Fortea 723 Over a hundred norovirus cases hit the cruise ship "Caribbean Princess" during Caribbean voyage More than 100 people have fallen ill aboard the cruise ship "Caribbean Princess" due to an outbreak of norovirus , a highly contagious virus that causes acute gastroenteritis. This has been reported by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. In total, of the 3,116 passengers traveling on the ship, 102 reported gastrointestinal symptoms, along with 13 crew members, bringing the total number of affected individuals to 115 . The most common symptoms reported include vomiting and diarrhea. The cruise ship "Caribbean Princess" (IMO 9215490) set sail under the Bermuda flag from Fort Lauderdale (Florida) on April 28 and completed its itinerary on May 11 in Port Canaveral . The cruise line Princess Cruises has stated that this is “a limited number of cases with mild gastrointestinal symptoms.” The ship "Caribbean Princess" will undergo thorough cleaning and disinfection before starting its next itinerary. news.content: Skip to main content Seoul Economic Daily Markets Property Finance Business Technology Politics Society Culture Sports International Opinion AI KEY Seoul Economic Daily August 12, 2026 (Wed) KSTSign In Seoul Economic Daily Korea's Leading Business News Since 1960 한국어 Markets Property Finance Business Technology Politics Society Culture Sports International Opinion AI KEY KOSPI6,345.53▲+0.73% KOSDAQ857.84▲+7.39% USD/KRW1,412.76▼-0.35% EUR/KRW1,629.70▼-0.38% KOSPI6,345.53▲+0.73% KOSDAQ857.84▲+7.39% USD/KRW1,412.76▼-0.35% EUR/KRW1,629.70▼-0.38% KOSPI6,345.53▲+0.73% KOSDAQ857.84▲+7.39% USD/KRW1,412.76▼-0.35% EUR/KRW1,629.70▼-0.38% KOSPI6,345.53▲+0.73% KOSDAQ857.84▲+7.39% USD/KRW1,412.76▼-0.35% EUR/KRW1,629.70▼-0.38% Menu Saved ArticlesNewslettersAI KEYSettings Korea Food Poisoning Cases Jump 28% as Salmonella, Norovirus Surge Culture| Published 2026.08.07. 13:33:14 | By Hyun Su-a |Summary|Save AAA Clipartkorea The number of food poisoning patients in Korea approached 10,000 last year, surging 28% from the previous year, as cases linked to mishandled eggs increasingly sent entire families to emergency rooms. The Ministry of Food and Drug Safety said on the 7th that there were a total of 319 food poisoning outbreaks in the country last year, with 9,780 patients. Compared with 2024 (265 cases, 7,624 patients), the number of outbreaks rose 20% and the number of patients increased 28%. The cause was a combined rise in salmonella and norovirus. For salmonella, cross-contamination of ingredients such as eggs was cited as a major factor, while for norovirus, poor personal hygiene management was the main cause. Nationwide, outbreaks centered on restaurants, with bacterial food poisoning prominent in summer and viral food poisoning in winter. By pathogen, salmonella accounted for 79 cases and 4,248 patients, or 43% of all patients. Food poisoning from this bacterium has traced an upward curve for five consecutive years, rising from 32 cases in 2021, 44 in 2022, 48 in 2023 and 58 in 2024 to 79 last year. Norovirus also produced 68 cases, up 31 from the previous year, while salmonella rose by 21 cases, with both pathogens showing a clear upward trend. In terms of timing, September was the most frequent with 45 cases and 1,475 patients. It was followed by August with 42 cases, July with 37 and January with 30. The ministry analyzed that bacterial food poisoning tends to increase in the hot and humid weather of summer, while viral food poisoning such as norovirus rises in winter. By season, summer had the highest share at 34%, but in terms of growth rate alone, the increase in winter was the most pronounced. By location, restaurants accounted for 192 cases, an overwhelming share exceeding 60% of the total. They were followed by group catering facilities with 47 cases and schools with 36. As dining out has increased, restaurant-related food poisoning has accounted for more than half of cases every year. By type of business, outbreaks occurred especially often at Korean restaurants, lunchbox and snack shops, and sashimi and Japanese restaurants. Among schools, elementary schools were a major source, while among group catering facilities, corporate cafeterias were cited. Regarding preventive measures, the ministry recommended always washing hands after handling eggs and heating food to a core temperature of 75 degrees or higher for at least one minute during cooking. To prevent the spread of salmonella, blocking cross-contamination when handling eggs is key, it explained. As for the foods responsible, complex cooked foods such as school meals and gimbap were most commonly identified at 62 cases, followed by fish and shellfish and meat. A notable point was eggs. Although there were only 14 outbreaks, the 2,392 related patients accounted for 24% of the total, classifying eggs as a food with a large scale of harm per case. By region, Gyeonggi (53 cases), Busan (39 cases) and Seoul (34 cases) had the most outbreaks, showing a pattern that generally corresponded to population size. However, based on the number of patients per one million population, Daejeon was highest at 685, followed by Jeju at 479 and North Chungcheong at 375, painting a different picture of regional risk. The ministry said that based on these results, it plans to expand advance inspections of vulnerable facilities and tailored preventive publicity, and to continue safety management measures suited to the characteristics of each season and cause. analysis.location_and_population: Republic of Korea (South Korea); outbreaks reported nationwide with regional data for Gyeonggi, Busan, Seoul, Daejeon, Jeju, and North Chungcheong.
analysis.event: Reported increase in food poisoning outbreaks and cases in 2025 compared to 2024, attributed to Salmonella and norovirus; official data released by the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety.
analysis.scale_impact_and_risk: 319 outbreaks and 9,780 patients in 2025, a 20% rise in outbreaks and 28% rise in patients compared to 2024 (265 outbreaks, 7,624 patients). Salmonella accounted for 79 outbreaks and 4,248 patients (43% of total); norovirus accounted for 68 outbreaks (31 more than 2024). Eggs were implicated in 14 outbreaks with 2,392 patients (24% of total). Restaurants accounted for 192 outbreaks (over 60% of total). Regional risk per million population highest in Daejeon (685), Jeju (479), and North Chungcheong (375).
analysis.response_status_and_uncertainty: Ministry of Food and Drug Safety recommended handwashing after handling eggs and cooking food to at least 75°C for one minute; emphasized blocking cross-contamination with eggs to prevent Salmonella. Plans include expanding advance inspections of vulnerable facilities and tailored preventive publicity. Seasonal patterns noted: bacterial food poisoning peaks in summer, viral (including norovirus) in winter. Data reflects official surveillance; no indication of underreporting adjustments.

analysis.brief_en: South Korea’s food poisoning cases surged 28% in 2025, with 9,780 patients and 319 outbreaks reported by the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety. Salmonella and norovirus were the leading causes, with Salmonella responsible for 4,248 cases (43% of total) and norovirus for 68 outbreaks. Restaurants accounted for over 60% of outbreaks, while eggs were implicated in 14 outbreaks affecting 2,392 people. Regional risk per million population was highest in Daejeon, Jeju, and North Chungcheong. Authorities urged improved hygiene and cooking practices, including handwashing after handling eggs and heating food to 75°C for at least one minute, and announced plans to expand targeted inspections and public awareness campaigns.

analysis_en.scale_impact_and_risk: 319 outbreaks and 9,780 patients in 2025, a 20% rise in outbreaks and 28% rise in patients compared to 2024 (265 outbreaks, 7,624 patients). Salmonella accounted for 79 outbreaks and 4,248 patients (43% of total); norovirus accounted for 68 outbreaks (31 more than 2024). Eggs were implicated in 14 outbreaks with 2,392 patients (24% of total). Restaurants accounted for 192 outbreaks (over 60% of total). Regional risk per million population highest in Daejeon (685), Jeju (479), and North Chungcheong (375).
analysis_en.response_status_and_uncertainty: Ministry of Food and Drug Safety recommended handwashing after handling eggs and cooking food to at least 75°C for one minute; emphasized blocking cross-contamination with eggs to prevent Salmonella. Plans include expanding advance inspections of vulnerable facilities and tailored preventive publicity. Seasonal patterns noted: bacterial food poisoning peaks in summer, viral (including norovirus) in winter. Data reflects official surveillance; no indication of underreporting adjustments.

news.content_title: Over a dozen sickened in fourth gastrointestinal illness outbreak on cruise ship in two months
news.content: Over a dozen sickened in fourth gastrointestinal illness outbreak on cruise ship in two months Over a dozen people were sickened with gastrointestinal illness on a National Geographic-Lindblad Expeditions cruise in the vessel’s fourth outbreak in a less than two-month period, according to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. Eight of the 57 guests and five crew members on board National Geographic Sea Bird reported feeling ill during its July 15 voyage, the CDC said. Their main symptoms were reported to be abdominal cramps, vomiting and diarrhea. The cause of the illness is currently unknown, the CDC said. In response to this gastrointestinal illness outbreak, Lindblad Expeditions and crew aboard the ship increased cleaning and disinfection procedures, isolated the ill passengers and crew, consulted with Vessel Sanitation Program (VSP) about sanitation cleaning procedures and reporting ill cases, and paused passenger operations. Lindblad told USA TODAY in an emailed statement that it canceled three voyages scheduled to embark on July 20, July 25 and July 30 “to conduct enhanced sanitation protocols aligned with the highest industry standards and provide additional time to help prevent the risk of further cases.” “We are working directly with affected guests to provide refunds, support and alternative travel arrangements,” the company added. The ship is currently en route to Ketchikan, Alaska, according to CruiseMapper.com. These new gastrointestinal illness cases follow three other outbreaks on the ship since late May. The first two were caused by norovirus while the third remains unknown, the CDC said. Outbreak of diarrhea-causing parasite expands to 4 more states Gastrointestinal illness (GI) is a common term for acute gastroenteritis (AGE), which has symptoms described as vomiting along with one of the following symptoms: diarrhea, muscle aches, headache, abdominal cramps or fever. Cruise ships are required to report these cases to the CDC. Norovirus is often a cause of gastrointestinal illness outbreaks on cruise ships, but the cause is not often found until an investigation has been completed. The CDC reported nine outbreaks of gastrointestinal illness on cruise ships that met the threshold for public notification so far this year. Norovirus was listed as the cause of five, and two others were caused by E.coli. The rest are still unknown. Copyright 2026 Nexstar Media, Inc. All rights reserved.
